digest.component_or_area: metrics/blame derivation and ticket id resolution
propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit-subject fragments and then hangs for minutes after the close durably commits
derive_caused_by performs O(commits × tickets) work by re-resolving the bug_id on every commit in the branch history with no caching or quiet resolution
Commit-subject candidates are incorrectly resolved as ticket references via the non-quiet path, causing alias-scan filesystem overhead for every candidate on every commit
Bare 4-hex fragments must no longer be treated as ticket reference candidates in optional caused-by derivation, while full ids, 8-hex prefixes, and aliases remain resolvable
Documentation must stop advertising bare 4-digit hex forms as a supported ticket reference method and instead positively name alias, 8-digit prefix, full id, and Jira forms
